verdict.rationale: Gemini is fundamentally a natural-language chat/voice assistant: users type or speak commands (Gemini Live for free-flowing conversation, 'Hey Google' voice commands) and Gemini can take actions in other apps ('help you take actions, like editing and managing your content in other apps'), schedule recurring actions, summarize emails, create calendar events, and manage code/documents—all via NL requests rather than manual UI operations. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming reliability of NL-triggered agentic actions (e.g., Connected Apps) beyond vendor documentation.
